modelRouting.routingRationale: Bounded Rust correction with exact public interface, exact file ownership, existing executor reuse, & adversarial failure corpus

objective: Implement & freeze corrected M5 typed external-project-tool boundary before dependent M4 lanes: argv-only requests, immediate policy evaluation, actual bounded version evidence, immutable outputs, process-tree control, truthful terminal receipts, provider-level typed degradation, & no Legion runtime re-entry.
integrationOwner: current orchestrator; sole owner of integration worktree HEAD, index, validation, commits, receipts, push, & later milestone gates; may not edit worker-owned implementation paths

ownershipCorrection.reason: Fresh rebaseline proved provider SDK cannot truthfully close M5 while native executor omits policy version/digest/outcome from receipts & accepts caller-asserted version probe output. M0-D005 jointly assigns policy/receipt migration & external-tool boundary to M4/M5. Corrected M5 owns only four necessary executor contract files plus existing SDK scope.
ownershipCorrection.legacyRule: All Node/Python runtime paths remain read-only evidence until M7; no Membrane path is readable or writable by worker.
ownershipCorrection.testRegistration: M5-owned legion-provider-sdk/Cargo.toml registers ../../tests/m5_provider_boundary.rs; no testkit manifest amendment is needed.

interfaceLock.executor: legion-effects remains sole process executor. ExternalToolRequest contains executable + argv, never shell command text; shell=true remains rejected. Caller-supplied version output/exit fields are removed. EffectExecutor runs requested version_args as a bounded argv-only post-policy probe through same PlatformProcess, then executes requested tool only when digest & actual version evidence qualify.
interfaceLock.receipt: ExecutionReceipt exposes policy id, version, digest, allowed outcome/reason, executable digest & actual version-probe evidence, redacted argv shape, cwd, environment names, sandbox, process-tree, timing, immutable stdout/stderr artifacts, parser state, terminal state, completeness, & gaps. Every post-policy terminal path binds exact policy evidence; pre-policy invalid requests remain explicitly incomplete.
interfaceLock.providerSdk: legion-provider-sdk::external_project_tool re-exports existing effects request/receipt/state types & defines one async ExternalProjectTool trait. EffectExecutor implements that trait; ProviderContext accepts optional injected Arc<dyn ExternalProjectTool>, exposes a builder/accessor & bounded async execution using context cancellation/deadline, & returns an incomplete blocked receipt with external_project_tool_unavailable when absent. SDK never spawns processes, evaluates policy, writes artifacts, or implements a second receipt.
interfaceLock.truth: Missing, denied, unsealed, unqualified, timed out, cancelled, output-limited, non-zero, cleanup-failed, artifact-failed, or unavailable execution never reports complete & never becomes empty Provider success. Blueprint absence remains provider-level typed degradation without aborting independent providers.

completionChecks: all actual changes are contained in exact ten-path allowlist & legacy/Membrane paths remain untouched
provider SDK compiles against one effects-owned request/receipt contract with no duplicate executor or shell-string path
denial, timeout, cancellation, output limit, unavailable executor, process cleanup failure, executable mismatch, actual version failure, & artifact failure each yield bound incomplete receipts
focused direct-Cargo checks pass; interface bytes are frozen before dependent M4 dispatch creation

workers.executor: Alchemist Rust worker in isolated worktree; no commit or push

from engine: cargo test -p legion-testkit --test native_effects --locked
search changed Rust for Command shell invocation, shell=true acceptance, Node/Python/PowerShell runtime re-entry, caller-supplied version output, missing receipt paths, & false complete states

worker-owned path is dirty before execution
implementation requires any path outside exact allowlist
